name: Battle Rope Slam
steps: Stand facing the anchor in an athletic half-squat stance holding one rope handle in each hand with slight slack.
Extend your hips and knees explosively while raising both arms high overhead to lift the heavy ropes.
Drop rapidly back into your athletic squat while whipping both ropes forcefully down into the floor in unison.
Continue slamming continuously with powerful full-body rhythm for the target duration.
tips: Brace your core and keep your back flat as you drop into each slam rather than rounding forward.
Drive every slam with your hips and lats together instead of relying only on your forearms.
